listing.name: Dynasty Warriors 5: Xtreme Legends — dw5xl-recomp (TheSlackbringer)
listing.summary: In development; tested scenes and modes are not complete playthrough; extended stability/scaling open. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own English PAL SLES53860 ISO. The optional Load Original feature also needs your own base Dynasty Warriors 5 SLES53339 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the released Windows package to build the game locally. Linux requires building from source; follow upstream’s platform instructions.

warnings: This project is in development. Upstream’s tested scenes and modes do not establish a complete playthrough; extended stability and scaling still need testing.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
